payload.reason: The evidence describes the process of generating adversarial attack examples by modifying contextual sentences in a specific challenge set, ContraPro, to evaluate translation models.

claims.text: Adversarial attack examples are generated by making small changes to contextual sentences in the ContraPro challenge set.
The process involves marking detection, coreference resolution, and language translation steps.
The modifications target theoretically inconsequential parts of the context sentence to test model robustness.
The results show that accuracy degrades across all adversarial attacks conducted on the models.
